summary_en: Daiichi Jitsugyo will cancel 500,000 common shares (1.5% of shares outstanding before cancellation) effective October 15, 2026, on a Board resolution dated September 24, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On September 24, 2026, Daiichi Jitsugyo's Board of Directors approved the cancellation of 500,000 treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares represent 1.5% of the 32,759,200 shares outstanding prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation effective October 15, 2026, the company will have 32,259,200 shares outstanding. As of August 31, 2026, the company held 806,630 treasury shares, which will remain outstanding after this cancellation.
